offersHint: Live franchised-dealer inventory, quotes, and consented salesperson handoffs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://gateway.agenticdealernetwork.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: network_directory
toolsPreview.description: Directory of active ADN rooftops: slug, name, dealer group, OEM programs, location metadata, and per-rooftop manifest URL.

toolsPreview.name: network_search
toolsPreview.description: Search available inventory across the network. Results are slim summary rows; embed hero_photo_url as a markdown image when presenting a vehicle, and call inventory_get with rooftop_slug for its full photo gallery. Optional OEM program scope; optional geographic radius — latitude, longitude, and radius_miles must appear together (all-or-none). Rooftops without coordinates are excluded from geo-scoped results.

toolsPreview.name: inventory_get
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one available unit by identity (VIN) from a named rooftop (rooftop_slug from network_search results). Returns the full detail shape — ordered photo gallery, options, plain-text description; embed the first few photo_urls as markdown images when presenting the vehicle. Unknown or ineligible identity/rooftop returns unit_not_found.

toolsPreview.name: deal_quote
toolsPreview.description: Out-the-door quote for one available unit at a named rooftop. Anonymous calls are stateless; authenticated calls persist a deal thread.

toolsPreview.name: lead_prepare
toolsPreview.description: Prepare a named dealership's exact contact disclosure and a short-lived signed binding.

toolsPreview.name: lead_submit
toolsPreview.description: Submit the shopper's bound contact request to the named dealership.
